mentions.name: Rust TTF font renderer
mentions.description: An experimental font renderer written in Rust. It reads the TTF file format and renders glyphs from straight-line outlines, with ongoing work on the harder parts: bezier curves, contours, and filling glyph interiors. Rendering implementations were checked quickly by plotting glyph outlines in MATLAB using the patch function.
mentions.problem: Rendering fonts correctly is hard: handling bezier curves, contours, and filling glyph interiors, whereas straight-line outlines are straightforward to render.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been experimenting with rendering fonts in Rust lately. I was pleasantly surprised by how simple reading the ttf file format is.
